security.component: Elation Health RAG Integration - Security & Vulnerability Assessment
security.threat_model: Healthcare AI system processing PHI and clinical decisions

findings.issue: No format validation on MRN parameter
findings.attack: Arbitrary MRN values could be used to scan for patient existence
findings.recommendation: Validate MRN format against institutional standards (regex)

findings.issue: include/search_fields parameters not validated against whitelist
findings.vulnerability: CWE-89: SQL Injection (potential if database backend used)
findings.recommendation: Implement whitelist validation: allowed = {'problems', 'medications', 'labs', 'alerts', 'history'}

findings.issue: time_window parameter accepts any string
findings.recommendation: Validate against whitelist: ['1w', '1m', '6m', '1y', 'all']

findings.issue: Medication strings from API directly used in requests
findings.vulnerability: CWE-78: OS Command Injection (if backend uses shell)
findings.recommendation: Add regex whitelist: /^[A-Za-z0-9\-]+$/ for drug names

findings.issue: No authentication tokens required for clinical endpoints
findings.vulnerability: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
findings.impact: Any unauthenticated user can access ALL patient clinical data
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2/JWT authentication on all clinical endpoints

findings.issue: No authorization check - all users can access all patients
findings.vulnerability: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access control (RBAC) with patient-user mapping

findings.issue: CORS allows all origins (*)
findings.vulnerability: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site
findings.recommendation: Restrict CORS to specific frontend domain(s)

findings.issue: No HTTPS enforcement in FastAPI app configuration
findings.recommendation: Use HTTPS in production, set HSTS headers, implement SSL/TLS

findings.issue: No encryption headers specified (Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options)
findings.recommendation: Add middleware for security headers

findings.issue: Sample patient data stored in JSON file without encryption
findings.vulnerability: CWE-312: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information
findings.recommendation: Use encrypted database (AWS RDS with encryption, Azure SQL)
findings.note: Sample data is OK for dev, but production must use encrypted DB

findings.issue: Patient MRN, names logged in function calls (console.error in frontend)
findings.recommendation: Never log PHI - use error codes instead

findings.detail: React properly escapes text content
findings.note: React JSX provides XSS protection by default

findings.issue: Medication data from API could contain malicious content
findings.detail: While React escapes, API should never send HTML
findings.recommendation: Validate API responses on backend before sending to frontend

findings.detail: encodeURIComponent used for condition names

findings.issue: If backend switches to SQL database, search queries could be vulnerable
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries/ORM always

findings.issue: Real patient names, MRNs, dates of birth exposed in API responses
findings.recommendation: Use patient IDs only, never transmit names/DOB unless necessary

findings.issue: All clinical data (problems, medications, labs) exposed without access controls
findings.recommendation: Implement granular access control based on clinician role

findings.issue: No audit trail of who accessed which patient data
findings.hipaa_requirement: HIPAA requires audit logs for all PHI access
findings.recommendation: Log all API calls with: user_id, patient_id, timestamp, endpoint, action

findings.issue: No consent management for data access
findings.recommendation: Implement consent workflow before accessing patient data

findings.issue: No rate limiting on endpoints
findings.vulnerability: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits
findings.attack: Attacker can brute-force all MRNs or exhaust resources
findings.recommendation: Implement rate limiting: 100 requests/minute per IP

findings.detail: FastAPI provides some validation via type hints
findings.improvement: Add Pydantic models for all request bodies

findings.issue: Server errors may expose internal details
findings.recommendation: Implement global exception handler to mask server errors
Implement API versioning (e.g., /api/v1/) for safe updates

findings.issue: Limited interaction database - only 3 drugs have interactions defined
findings.recommendation: Expand to comprehensive drug interaction database (e.g., Micromedex)

findings.detail: Guidelines dated 2024 - current and evidence-based
Recommendations align with ACC/AHA and ADA standards
Dose ranges verified against standard references

findings.issue: No mechanism to report adverse events or system errors
findings.recommendation: Implement MedWatch integration for adverse event reporting

findings.detail: All patient data exposed without role-based filtering
findings.hipaa_requirement: Only access minimum necessary data for clinical purpose

findings.detail: No user authentication implemented
No authorization implemented
No audit logging of PHI access

findings.issue: requirements.txt not reviewed
findings.recommendation: Review and audit all dependencies, use dependency scanning tools
Run: pip audit, npm audit, Snyk to detect vulnerabilities
